title: Briefing: Canada's Pacific Link pipeline fight
script: This is the Unowned briefing for Tuesday, October twenty-seventh. It's narrated by a synthetic voice, and every fact comes from our checked timelines.

British Columbia's Conservative Party wins a majority government in the snap election Premier David Eby called for October twenty-fourth, in which the pipeline was a campaign issue, CTV News declares; CBC News and The Canadian Press separately report the Conservative majority win. That's confirmed by independent reports. What's next: the October twenty-sixth First Nations-First Ministers meeting and the National Day of Action planned outside it.
That's the briefing. Full timelines, and every source, are at unowned news dot com.
